target_customer: Marketers at startups and growth companies, largely in India, sending email campaigns
problem: Email conversion needs multiple clicks and page loads. Mailmodo lets marketers embed forms, carts, calendars and NPS widgets inside the email using AMP, without code.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for email marketing, tiered by contacts and sends

founders.name: Aquibur Rahman
founders.background_notes: Headed marketing at Cleartax, growing organic traffic 5x in a year, per the YC page.

founders.name: Apurv Gupta
education: IIT and IIM graduate per YourStory headline, unverified detail
previous_startups: Flick2Know (built FieldAssist to 3M ARR without external funding)
founders.background_notes: Over 13 years building B2B SaaS per the YC page.

competitors.name: Mailchimp
competitors.what: General email marketing platform without AMP interactivity

technical_complexity.rationale: AMP for Email was new and unevenly supported across clients, so a no code builder with fallbacks was real engineering, on top of standard ESP infrastructure.

defensibility.rationale: First mover in no code AMP email, but large ESPs could add AMP templates and email clients limited support.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbents copying it; the company later shifted positioning toward AI email marketing.

market_need_then: Google made AMP for Email public and early coverage said most ESPs did not support it, leaving a niche; Indian startups were adopting SaaS marketing tools.

identity.voice_and_tone: Pitches app-like emails and later AI autopilot

branding.community_and_virality: Marketplace listings on HubSpot and Shopify and reviews on G2; no evidence of a fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: Known within its niche with named customers like Razorpay and bigbasket, but no sourced brand press or community.

outcome_analysis: Mailmodo rode the opening of AMP for Email, raising a 270 thousand dollar pre-seed in January 2021 and a 2 million dollar seed from Surge and YC in July 2021. YC lists it as acquired, but no buyer is named and the company site in 2026 shows no ownership change, so the status is unverified. It reached 70 staff per YC and customers such as Razorpay and bigbasket per its own site.
notes: YC says Acquired but Employbl says not and the live site shows no notice; exit type left unknown. A third founder, Devyesh Tandon, appears in some sources only. CB Insights lists a 0.5M convertible note (2021-08) and an undisclosed 2022-01 round, unverified single aggregator. Competitor detail is thin: only Mailchimp is sourced as of 2021.
